queryLines:
WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name,
         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'City' WHEN 'municipality' THEN 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label,
         d.lgu_type, d.city_class, d.income_class, d.land_area_sqkm
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
n12 AS (
  SELECT a1.city_mun_psgc_code,
         CASE WHEN a1.learners_per_public_school IS NOT NULL AND a1.ap1_coverage_pct >= 90 THEN 100.0 * PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
           PARTITION BY a1.learners_per_public_school IS NOT NULL AND a1.ap1_coverage_pct >= 90 ORDER BY a1.learners_per_public_school) END AS ap1_pct_national,
         CASE WHEN a2.learners_per_room IS NOT NULL AND a2.learner_coverage_pct >= 90 THEN 100.0 * PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
           PARTITION BY a2.learners_per_room IS NOT NULL AND a2.learner_coverage_pct >= 90 ORDER BY a2.learners_per_room) END AS ap2_pct_national
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap1_school_provision AS a1
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap2_classroom_pressure AS a2
    ON a2.city_mun_psgc_code = a1.city_mun_psgc_code AND a2.school_year = a1.school_year
  WHERE a1.school_year = '2023-24'
),
n3_lvl AS (
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code, education_level_code, schools_in_scope > 0 AS offered,
         COALESCE(schools_in_scope > 0 AND learners_per_teacher IS NOT NULL AND learner_coverage_pct >= 90, FALSE) AS level_ok,
         learners_per_teacher
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure
  WHERE school_year = '2023-24'
),
n3_rl AS (
  SELECT n3_lvl.*,
         CASE WHEN level_ok THEN PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY education_level_code, level_ok ORDER BY learners_per_teacher) END AS level_pct
  FROM n3_lvl
),
n3_a AS (
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code, COUNT_IF(offered) AS levels_offered, COUNT_IF(level_ok) AS levels_assessed,
         MAX(level_pct) AS top_level_pct,
         MAX_BY(CASE WHEN level_ok THEN education_level_code END, COALESCE(level_pct, -1.0)) AS top_level_national
  FROM n3_rl
  GROUP BY city_mun_psgc_code
),
n3 AS (
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code, levels_offered, levels_assessed, top_level_national,
         CASE WHEN levels_assessed > 0 THEN 100.0 * PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY levels_assessed > 0 ORDER BY top_level_pct) END AS ap3_pct_national
  FROM n3_a
),
ap1_prev AS (
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code,
         MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2023-24' THEN active_public_schools END) AS active_schools_2023,
         MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2022-23' THEN active_public_schools END) AS active_schools_2022,
         MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2023-24' THEN public_learners END) AS public_learners_2023,
         MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2022-23' THEN public_learners END) AS public_learners_2022,
         MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2023-24' THEN barangays_without_public_es END) AS barangays_without_es_2023,
         MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2023-24' THEN regular_barangays END) AS regular_barangays,
         MAX(population_2024) AS population_2024
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap1_school_provision
  GROUP BY city_mun_psgc_code
),
ap4 AS (
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2024 THEN school_age_population END) AS school_age_pop_2024,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2020 THEN school_age_population END) AS school_age_pop_2020,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2024 THEN enrollment_all_sectors END) AS enrollment_2024,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2020 THEN enrollment_all_sectors END) AS enrollment_2020,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2024 THEN population_enrollment_gap END) AS gap_2024,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2020 THEN population_enrollment_gap END) AS gap_2020,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2024 THEN gap_share END) AS gap_share_2024
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap4_population_enrollment_gap
  GROUP BY city_mun_psgc_code
),
scoped AS (
  SELECT l.lgu_label, l.province_label, l.lgu_type_label, l.land_area_sqkm,
         p.*,
         n12.ap1_pct_national, n12.ap2_pct_national, n3.ap3_pct_national, n3.top_level_national,
         CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN n12.ap1_pct_national ELSE 100.0 * p.ap1_percentile END AS ap1_pct_view,
         CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN n12.ap2_pct_national ELSE 100.0 * p.ap2_percentile END AS ap2_pct_view,
         CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN n3.ap3_pct_national ELSE 100.0 * p.ap3_percentile END AS ap3_pct_view,
         CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN p.national_tier_code ELSE p.tier_code END AS tier_code_view,
         CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN n3.top_level_national ELSE p.ap3_highest_level END AS ap3_level_view,
         a.active_schools_2023, a.active_schools_2022, a.public_learners_2023, a.public_learners_2022,
         a.barangays_without_es_2023, a.regular_barangays, a.population_2024,
         g.school_age_pop_2024, g.school_age_pop_2020, g.enrollment_2024, g.enrollment_2020, g.gap_2024, g.gap_2020, g.gap_share_2024,
         pv.poverty_incidence, pv.poverty_status
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority AS p
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN n12 ON n12.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN n3 ON n3.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN ap1_prev AS a ON a.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN ap4 AS g ON g.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_poverty AS pv ON pv.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
),
gap_ranked AS (
  SELECT scoped.*,
         CASE WHEN gap_share_2024 IS NOT NULL THEN 100.0 * PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN 'all' ELSE lgu_type END, gap_share_2024 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY gap_share_2024) END AS ap4_pct_view
  FROM scoped
),
board AS (
  SELECT gap_ranked.*,
         CASE tier_code_view WHEN '3' THEN 'Critical' WHEN '2' THEN 'Elevated' WHEN '1' THEN 'Targeted' WHEN '0' THEN 'Monitor' ELSE 'Data review' END AS tier_view,
         CASE tier_code_view WHEN '3' THEN 4 WHEN '2' THEN 3 WHEN '1' THEN 2 WHEN '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tier_sort_view,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN ap1_pct_view >= 90 THEN 'Schools' END,
                                          CASE WHEN ap2_pct_view >= 90 THEN 'Classrooms' END,
                                          CASE WHEN ap3_pct_view >= 90 THEN 'Teachers' END), ''), 'None high') AS high_measures_view,
         CASE WHEN is_stable THEN 'Critical in both rankings'
              WHEN tier_code = '3' THEN 'Critical within type only'
              WHEN national_tier_code = '3' THEN 'Critical nationally only'
              ELSE 'Not Critical' END AS stability,
         CASE ap3_level_view WHEN 'ES' THEN ap3_es_learners_per_teacher WHEN 'JHS' THEN ap3_jhs_learners_per_teacher
              WHEN 'SHS' THEN ap3_shs_learners_per_teacher END AS ap3_value_view,
         population_2024 / NULLIF(CAST(land_area_sqkm AS DOUBLE), 0) AS density_per_sqkm,
         LEAST(ap1_pct_view, ap2_pct_view, ap3_pct_view) AS lowest_pct_view
  FROM gap_ranked
)
SELECT board.*,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tier_sort_view DESC, affected_learners DESC, lowest_pct_view DESC, city_mun_psgc_code) AS rank_in_view,
       CASE WHEN tier_sort_view >= 3 THEN affected_learners ELSE 0 END AS learners_in_critical_elevated
FROM board
WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)

WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name,
         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'City' WHEN 'municipality' THEN 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label,
         d.lgu_type, d.city_class, d.income_class, d.land_area_sqkm
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
base AS (
  SELECT a.*, l.lgu_label, l.province_label, l.lgu_type_label,
         LAG(a.active_public_schools) OVER (PARTITION BY a.city_mun_psgc_code ORDER BY a.school_year) AS prev_active_public_schools,
         LAG(a.public_learners) OVER (PARTITION BY a.city_mun_psgc_code ORDER BY a.school_year) AS prev_public_learners,
         LAG(a.complete_total_schools) OVER (PARTITION BY a.city_mun_psgc_code ORDER BY a.school_year) AS prev_complete_total_schools,
         LAG(a.barangays_without_public_es) OVER (PARTITION BY a.city_mun_psgc_code ORDER BY a.school_year) AS prev_barangays_without_public_es,
         CASE WHEN a.population_status = 'available' THEN 10000.0 * a.active_public_schools / NULLIF(a.population_2024, 0) END AS schools_per_10k_residents,
         COALESCE(a.learners_per_public_school IS NOT NULL AND a.ap1_coverage_pct >= 90, FALSE) AS is_assessed
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap1_school_provision AS a
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = a.city_mun_psgc_code
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT base.*, CASE WHEN is_assessed THEN 100.0 * PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN 'all' ELSE lgu_type END, is_assessed, school_year ORDER BY learners_per_public_school) END AS ap1_pct_view
  FROM base
  WHERE school_year = :school_year
)
SELECT ranked.*,
       CASE WHEN ap1_pct_view IS NULL THEN 'Not assessed (coverage under 90%)' WHEN ap1_pct_view >= 90 THEN 'High (90th percentile or above)' ELSE 'Below the line' END AS high_flag,
       CASE WHEN active_public_schools = 0 THEN 'No active public school'
            WHEN barangays_without_public_es = 0 THEN 'Every barangay has one'
            ELSE 'Some barangays without one' END AS es_reach,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY learners_per_public_school DESC NULLS LAST, city_mun_psgc_code) AS rank_in_view,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY barangays_without_public_es_pct DESC NULLS LAST, barangays_without_public_es DESC, city_mun_psgc_code) AS es_rank_in_view,
       CAST(FLOOR(LEAST(learners_per_public_school, 1999) / 100) * 100 AS INT) AS learners_per_school_bin
FROM ranked
WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)

       SUM(a.active_public_schools) AS active_public_schools,

       SUM(a.barangays_without_public_es) AS barangays_without_public_es,

WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name,
         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'City' WHEN 'municipality' THEN 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label,
         d.lgu_type, d.city_class, d.income_class, d.land_area_sqkm
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
national AS (
  SELECT SUM(learners_in_ratio) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(rooms_in_ratio) AS DOUBLE), 0) AS national_learners_per_room
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap2_classroom_pressure WHERE school_year = '2023-24'
),
spaces AS (
  SELECT e.city_mun_psgc_code,
         SUM(r.temporary_learning_spaces) AS temporary_learning_spaces,
         SUM(r.makeshift_rooms) AS makeshift_rooms,
         SUM(r.classes_using_temporary_learning_spaces) AS classes_in_tls,
         SUM(r.classes_using_makeshift_rooms) AS classes_in_makeshift_rooms
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.fact_school_classroom_capacity AS r
  JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT school_id, school_year, city_mun_psgc_code FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.fact_school_enrollment WHERE sector = 'Public') AS e
    ON e.school_id = r.school_id AND e.school_year = r.school_year
  WHERE r.school_year = '2023-24'
  GROUP BY e.city_mun_psgc_code
),
outl AS (
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code, COUNT(*) AS outlier_schools_ap2
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_outlier_schools WHERE measure = 'AP2' GROUP BY city_mun_psgc_code
),
base AS (
  SELECT a.*, l.lgu_label, l.province_label, l.lgu_type_label, n.national_learners_per_room,
         COALESCE(s.temporary_learning_spaces, 0) AS temporary_learning_spaces,
         COALESCE(s.makeshift_rooms, 0) AS makeshift_rooms,
         COALESCE(s.classes_in_tls, 0) AS classes_in_tls,
         COALESCE(s.classes_in_makeshift_rooms, 0) AS classes_in_makeshift_rooms,
         COALESCE(o.outlier_schools_ap2, 0) AS outlier_schools_ap2,
         COALESCE(a.learners_per_room IS NOT NULL AND a.learner_coverage_pct >= 90, FALSE) AS is_assessed,
         90.0 AS coverage_gate_pct
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap2_classroom_pressure AS a
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = a.city_mun_psgc_code
  CROSS JOIN national AS n
  LEFT JOIN spaces AS s ON s.city_mun_psgc_code = a.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN outl AS o ON o.city_mun_psgc_code = a.city_mun_psgc_code
  WHERE a.school_year = '2023-24'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT base.*, CASE WHEN is_assessed THEN 100.0 * PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN 'all' ELSE lgu_type END, is_assessed ORDER BY learners_per_room) END AS ap2_pct_view FROM base
)
SELECT ranked.*,
       CASE WHEN ap2_pct_view IS NULL THEN 'Not assessed (coverage under 90%)' WHEN ap2_pct_view >= 90 THEN 'High (90th percentile or above)' ELSE 'Below the line' END AS high_flag,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY learners_per_room DESC NULLS LAST, city_mun_psgc_code) AS rank_in_view,
       CAST(FLOOR(LEAST(learners_per_room, 99) / 5) * 5 AS INT) AS learners_per_room_bin
FROM ranked
WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)

WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name,
         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'City' WHEN 'municipality' THEN 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label,
         d.lgu_type, d.city_class, d.income_class, d.land_area_sqkm
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
national AS (
  SELECT education_level_code,
         SUM(learners_in_ratio) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(teachers_in_ratio) AS DOUBLE), 0) AS national_learners_per_teacher
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure WHERE school_year = '2023-24' GROUP BY education_level_code
),
outl AS (
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code, education_level_code, COUNT(*) AS outlier_schools_level
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_outlier_schools WHERE measure = 'AP3' GROUP BY city_mun_psgc_code, education_level_code
),
base AS (
  SELECT t.*, l.lgu_label, l.province_label, l.lgu_type_label, n.national_learners_per_teacher,
         CASE t.education_level_code WHEN 'ES' THEN 'Elementary (ES)' WHEN 'JHS' THEN 'Junior high (JHS)' WHEN 'SHS' THEN 'Senior high (SHS)' END AS level_name,
         t.sef_provincial_teachers + t.sef_city_municipal_teachers + t.lgu_funded_teachers + t.other_funded_teachers AS locally_funded_teachers,
         COALESCE(o.outlier_schools_level, 0) AS outlier_schools_level,
         COALESCE(t.schools_in_scope > 0 AND t.learners_per_teacher IS NOT NULL AND t.learner_coverage_pct >= 90, FALSE) AS is_assessed
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure AS t
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = t.city_mun_psgc_code
  JOIN national AS n ON n.education_level_code = t.education_level_code
  LEFT JOIN outl AS o ON o.city_mun_psgc_code = t.city_mun_psgc_code AND o.education_level_code = t.education_level_code
  WHERE t.school_year = '2023-24' AND t.education_level_code = :level
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT base.*, CASE WHEN is_assessed THEN 100.0 * PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN 'all' ELSE lgu_type END, is_assessed ORDER BY learners_per_teacher) END AS ap3_pct_view FROM base
)
SELECT ranked.*,
       CASE WHEN ap3_pct_view IS NULL THEN 'Not assessed (coverage under 90%)' WHEN ap3_pct_view >= 90 THEN 'High (90th percentile or above)' ELSE 'Below the line' END AS high_flag,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY learners_per_teacher DESC NULLS LAST, city_mun_psgc_code) AS rank_in_view,
       CAST(FLOOR(LEAST(learners_per_teacher, 79) / 2.5) * 2.5 AS DOUBLE) AS learners_per_teacher_bin
FROM ranked
WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)

WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name,
         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'City' WHEN 'municipality' THEN 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label,
         d.lgu_type, d.city_class, d.income_class, d.land_area_sqkm
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
t AS (
  SELECT p.*, CASE p.education_level_code WHEN 'ES' THEN 'Elementary (ES)' WHEN 'JHS' THEN 'Junior high (JHS)' WHEN 'SHS' THEN 'Senior high (SHS)' END AS level_name,
         CASE p.education_level_code WHEN 'ES' THEN 1 WHEN 'JHS' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS level_sort
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure AS p
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
  WHERE p.school_year = '2023-24' AND (:region = 'All regions' OR l.region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR l.province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR l.lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
),
lv AS (
  SELECT level_name, level_sort,
         SUM(learners_in_ratio) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(teachers_in_ratio) AS DOUBLE), 0) AS learners_per_teacher,
         100.0 * SUM(learners_in_ratio) / NULLIF(SUM(level_learners), 0) AS learner_coverage_pct,
         SUM(learners_without_teachers) AS learners_without_teachers,
         SUM(zero_teacher_schools) AS zero_teacher_schools
  FROM t GROUP BY level_name, level_sort
),
f AS (
  SELECT level_name, 'National (DepEd)' AS funding, 1 AS funding_sort,
         SUM(teachers_in_ratio - sef_provincial_teachers - sef_city_municipal_teachers - lgu_funded_teachers - other_funded_teachers) AS teachers
  FROM t GROUP BY level_name
  UNION ALL SELECT level_name, 'SEF provincial', 2, SUM(sef_provincial_teachers) FROM t GROUP BY level_name
  UNION ALL SELECT level_name, 'SEF city or municipal', 3, SUM(sef_city_municipal_teachers) FROM t GROUP BY level_name
  UNION ALL SELECT level_name, 'LGU-funded', 4, SUM(lgu_funded_teachers) FROM t GROUP BY level_name
  UNION ALL SELECT level_name, 'Other funding', 5, SUM(other_funded_teachers) FROM t GROUP BY level_name
)
SELECT lv.*, f.funding, f.funding_sort, f.teachers,
       CASE WHEN f.funding_sort = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_first_row
FROM lv JOIN f ON f.level_name = lv.level_name

wide AS (

         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2024 THEN school_age_population END) AS school_age_pop_2024,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2020 THEN school_age_population END) AS school_age_pop_2020,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2024 THEN enrollment_all_sectors END) AS enrollment_2024,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2020 THEN enrollment_all_sectors END) AS enrollment_2020,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2024 THEN public_enrollment END) AS public_enrollment_2024,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2024 THEN population_enrollment_gap END) AS gap_2024,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2020 THEN population_enrollment_gap END) AS gap_2020,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2024 THEN gap_share END) AS gap_share_2024,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2020 THEN gap_share END) AS gap_share_2020,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2024 THEN public_school_share END) AS public_school_share_2024,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2024 THEN gap_change_2020_2024 END) AS gap_change_2020_2024,
         BOOL_AND(is_2020_2024_geography_comparable) AS is_comparable
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap4_population_enrollment_gap AS g
  GROUP BY g.city_mun_psgc_code
),
base AS (
  SELECT w.*, l.lgu_label, l.province_label, l.lgu_type_label, l.region_name, l.lgu_type,
         100.0 * (w.gap_share_2024 - w.gap_share_2020) AS gap_share_change_pp,
         CASE WHEN w.gap_2024 < 0 THEN 'School hub (more enrolled than resident)'
              WHEN w.gap_2024 IS NULL THEN 'No population' ELSE 'Resident gap' END AS gap_kind,
         CASE WHEN w.is_comparable THEN 'Comparable 2020 to 2024' ELSE 'Boundary or region changed' END AS comparability
  FROM wide AS w
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = w.city_mun_psgc_code
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT base.*, CASE WHEN gap_share_2024 IS NOT NULL THEN 100.0 * PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN 'all' ELSE lgu_type END, gap_share_2024 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY gap_share_2024) END AS ap4_pct_view FROM base
)
SELECT ranked.*,
       CASE WHEN ap4_pct_view IS NULL THEN 'Not assessed (coverage under 90%)' WHEN ap4_pct_view >= 90 THEN 'High (90th percentile or above)' ELSE 'Below the line' END AS high_flag,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY gap_share_2024 DESC NULLS LAST, city_mun_psgc_code) AS rank_in_view
FROM ranked
WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)

datasets.name: lgu_card
queryLines:
WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name,
         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'City' WHEN 'municipality' THEN 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label,
         d.lgu_type, d.city_class, d.income_class, d.land_area_sqkm
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
n12 AS (
  SELECT a1.city_mun_psgc_code,
         CASE WHEN a1.learners_per_public_school IS NOT NULL AND a1.ap1_coverage_pct >= 90 THEN 100.0 * PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
           PARTITION BY a1.learners_per_public_school IS NOT NULL AND a1.ap1_coverage_pct >= 90 ORDER BY a1.learners_per_public_school) END AS ap1_pct_national,
         CASE WHEN a2.learners_per_room IS NOT NULL AND a2.learner_coverage_pct >= 90 THEN 100.0 * PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
           PARTITION BY a2.learners_per_room IS NOT NULL AND a2.learner_coverage_pct >= 90 ORDER BY a2.learners_per_room) END AS ap2_pct_national
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap1_school_provision AS a1
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap2_classroom_pressure AS a2
    ON a2.city_mun_psgc_code = a1.city_mun_psgc_code AND a2.school_year = a1.school_year
  WHERE a1.school_year = '2023-24'
),
n3_lvl AS (
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code, education_level_code, schools_in_scope > 0 AS offered,
         COALESCE(schools_in_scope > 0 AND learners_per_teacher IS NOT NULL AND learner_coverage_pct >= 90, FALSE) AS level_ok,
         learners_per_teacher
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure
  WHERE school_year = '2023-24'
),
n3_rl AS (
  SELECT n3_lvl.*,
         CASE WHEN level_ok THEN PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY education_level_code, level_ok ORDER BY learners_per_teacher) END AS level_pct
  FROM n3_lvl
),
n3_a AS (
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code, COUNT_IF(offered) AS levels_offered, COUNT_IF(level_ok) AS levels_assessed,
         MAX(level_pct) AS top_level_pct,
         MAX_BY(CASE WHEN level_ok THEN education_level_code END, COALESCE(level_pct, -1.0)) AS top_level_national
  FROM n3_rl
  GROUP BY city_mun_psgc_code
),
n3 AS (
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code, levels_offered, levels_assessed, top_level_national,
         CASE WHEN levels_assessed > 0 THEN 100.0 * PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY levels_assessed > 0 ORDER BY top_level_pct) END AS ap3_pct_national
  FROM n3_a
),
ap1_prev AS (
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code,
         MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2023-24' THEN active_public_schools END) AS active_schools_2023,
         MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2022-23' THEN active_public_schools END) AS active_schools_2022,
         MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2023-24' THEN public_learners END) AS public_learners_2023,
         MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2022-23' THEN public_learners END) AS public_learners_2022,
         MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2023-24' THEN barangays_without_public_es END) AS barangays_without_es_2023,
         MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2023-24' THEN regular_barangays END) AS regular_barangays,
         MAX(population_2024) AS population_2024
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap1_school_provision
  GROUP BY city_mun_psgc_code
),
ap4 AS (
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2024 THEN school_age_population END) AS school_age_pop_2024,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2020 THEN school_age_population END) AS school_age_pop_2020,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2024 THEN enrollment_all_sectors END) AS enrollment_2024,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2020 THEN enrollment_all_sectors END) AS enrollment_2020,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2024 THEN population_enrollment_gap END) AS gap_2024,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2020 THEN population_enrollment_gap END) AS gap_2020,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2024 THEN gap_share END) AS gap_share_2024
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap4_population_enrollment_gap
  GROUP BY city_mun_psgc_code
),
scoped AS (
  SELECT l.lgu_label, l.province_label, l.lgu_type_label, l.land_area_sqkm,
         p.*,
         n12.ap1_pct_national, n12.ap2_pct_national, n3.ap3_pct_national, n3.top_level_national,
         CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN n12.ap1_pct_national ELSE 100.0 * p.ap1_percentile END AS ap1_pct_view,
         CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN n12.ap2_pct_national ELSE 100.0 * p.ap2_percentile END AS ap2_pct_view,
         CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN n3.ap3_pct_national ELSE 100.0 * p.ap3_percentile END AS ap3_pct_view,
         CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN p.national_tier_code ELSE p.tier_code END AS tier_code_view,
         CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN n3.top_level_national ELSE p.ap3_highest_level END AS ap3_level_view,
         a.active_schools_2023, a.active_schools_2022, a.public_learners_2023, a.public_learners_2022,
         a.barangays_without_es_2023, a.regular_barangays, a.population_2024,
         g.school_age_pop_2024, g.school_age_pop_2020, g.enrollment_2024, g.enrollment_2020, g.gap_2024, g.gap_2020, g.gap_share_2024,
         pv.poverty_incidence, pv.poverty_status
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority AS p
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN n12 ON n12.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN n3 ON n3.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN ap1_prev AS a ON a.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN ap4 AS g ON g.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_poverty AS pv ON pv.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
),
gap_ranked AS (
  SELECT scoped.*,
         CASE WHEN gap_share_2024 IS NOT NULL THEN 100.0 * PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN 'all' ELSE lgu_type END, gap_share_2024 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY gap_share_2024) END AS ap4_pct_view
  FROM scoped
),
board AS (
  SELECT gap_ranked.*,
         CASE tier_code_view WHEN '3' THEN 'Critical' WHEN '2' THEN 'Elevated' WHEN '1' THEN 'Targeted' WHEN '0' THEN 'Monitor' ELSE 'Data review' END AS tier_view,
         CASE tier_code_view WHEN '3' THEN 4 WHEN '2' THEN 3 WHEN '1' THEN 2 WHEN '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tier_sort_view,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN ap1_pct_view >= 90 THEN 'Schools' END,
                                          CASE WHEN ap2_pct_view >= 90 THEN 'Classrooms' END,
                                          CASE WHEN ap3_pct_view >= 90 THEN 'Teachers' END), ''), 'None high') AS high_measures_view,
         CASE WHEN is_stable THEN 'Critical in both rankings'
              WHEN tier_code = '3' THEN 'Critical within type only'
              WHEN national_tier_code = '3' THEN 'Critical nationally only'
              ELSE 'Not Critical' END AS stability,
         CASE ap3_level_view WHEN 'ES' THEN ap3_es_learners_per_teacher WHEN 'JHS' THEN ap3_jhs_learners_per_teacher
              WHEN 'SHS' THEN ap3_shs_learners_per_teacher END AS ap3_value_view,
         population_2024 / NULLIF(CAST(land_area_sqkm AS DOUBLE), 0) AS density_per_sqkm,
         LEAST(ap1_pct_view, ap2_pct_view, ap3_pct_view) AS lowest_pct_view
  FROM gap_ranked
),
sel AS (
  SELECT l.city_mun_psgc_code
  FROM lgu AS l
  JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority AS p ON p.city_mun_psgc_code = l.city_mun_psgc_code
  WHERE l.lgu_label = :lgu OR (:lgu = '(Top priority LGU in view)' AND (:region = 'All regions' OR l.region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR l.province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR l.lgu_type_label = :lgu_type))
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.lgu_label = :lgu THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.priority_rank
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT r.* FROM (
  SELECT board.*,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tier_sort_view DESC, affected_learners DESC, lowest_pct_view DESC, city_mun_psgc_code) AS rank_in_view
  FROM board
) AS r
JOIN sel ON sel.city_mun_psgc_code = r.city_mun_psgc_code

datasets.name: lgu_measures
queryLines:
WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name,
         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'City' WHEN 'municipality' THEN 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label,
         d.lgu_type, d.city_class, d.income_class, d.land_area_sqkm
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
sel AS (
  SELECT l.city_mun_psgc_code
  FROM lgu AS l
  JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority AS p ON p.city_mun_psgc_code = l.city_mun_psgc_code
  WHERE l.lgu_label = :lgu OR (:lgu = '(Top priority LGU in view)' AND (:region = 'All regions' OR l.region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR l.province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR l.lgu_type_label = :lgu_type))
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.lgu_label = :lgu THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.priority_rank
  LIMIT 1
),
m AS (
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code, 'Schools: learners per public school' AS measure, 1 AS measure_sort,
         learners_per_public_school AS value, COALESCE(learners_per_public_school IS NOT NULL AND ap1_coverage_pct >= 90, FALSE) AS ok
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap1_school_provision WHERE school_year = '2023-24'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code, 'Classrooms: learners per room', 2,
         learners_per_room, COALESCE(learners_per_room IS NOT NULL AND learner_coverage_pct >= 90, FALSE)
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap2_classroom_pressure WHERE school_year = '2023-24'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code, 'Teachers: learners per teacher (' || education_level_code || ')',
         CASE education_level_code WHEN 'ES' THEN 3 WHEN 'JHS' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,
         learners_per_teacher, COALESCE(schools_in_scope > 0 AND learners_per_teacher IS NOT NULL AND learner_coverage_pct >= 90, FALSE)
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure WHERE school_year = '2023-24'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code, 'Enrollment: school-age gap share 2024 (%)', 6, 100.0 * gap_share, gap_share IS NOT NULL
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap4_population_enrollment_gap WHERE reference_year = 2024
),
ml AS (
  SELECT m.*, l.lgu_type FROM m JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
),
scored AS (
  SELECT ml.*,
         CASE WHEN ok THEN 100.0 * PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY measure, lgu_type, ok ORDER BY value) END AS pct_type,
         CASE WHEN ok THEN 100.0 * PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY measure, ok ORDER BY value) END AS pct_national
  FROM ml
),
med AS (
  SELECT measure, lgu_type, MEDIAN(value) AS median_type FROM ml WHERE ok GROUP BY measure, lgu_type
),
med_n AS (
  SELECT measure, MEDIAN(value) AS median_national FROM ml WHERE ok GROUP BY measure
)
SELECT s.measure, s.measure_sort, 'Same LGU type' AS scope, 1 AS scope_sort, s.value AS lgu_value, s.ok AS is_assessed,
       s.pct_type AS percentile, md.median_type AS scope_median, s.value - md.median_type AS difference_from_median
FROM scored AS s
JOIN sel ON sel.city_mun_psgc_code = s.city_mun_psgc_code
JOIN med AS md ON md.measure = s.measure AND md.lgu_type = s.lgu_type
UNION ALL
SELECT s.measure, s.measure_sort, 'National', 2, s.value, s.ok,
       s.pct_national, mn.median_national, s.value - mn.median_national

         LAG(a.barangays_without_public_es) OVER (PARTITION BY a.city_mun_psgc_code ORDER BY a.school_year) AS prev_barangays_without_public_es,
         CASE WHEN a.population_status = 'available' THEN 10000.0 * a.active_public_schools / NULLIF(a.population_2024, 0) END AS schools_per_10k_residents,

SELECT * FROM (
WITH lgu AS (

  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
n12 AS (
  SELECT a1.city_mun_psgc_code,
         CASE WHEN a1.learners_per_public_school IS NOT NULL AND a1.ap1_coverage_pct >= 90 THEN 100.0 * PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
           PARTITION BY a1.learners_per_public_school IS NOT NULL AND a1.ap1_coverage_pct >= 90 ORDER BY a1.learners_per_public_school) END AS ap1_pct_national,
         CASE WHEN a2.learners_per_room IS NOT NULL AND a2.learner_coverage_pct >= 90 THEN 100.0 * PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
           PARTITION BY a2.learners_per_room IS NOT NULL AND a2.learner_coverage_pct >= 90 ORDER BY a2.learners_per_room) END AS ap2_pct_national
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap1_school_provision AS a1
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap2_classroom_pressure AS a2
    ON a2.city_mun_psgc_code = a1.city_mun_psgc_code AND a2.school_year = a1.school_year
  WHERE a1.school_year = '2023-24'
),
n3_lvl AS (
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code, education_level_code, schools_in_scope > 0 AS offered,
         COALESCE(schools_in_scope > 0 AND learners_per_teacher IS NOT NULL AND learner_coverage_pct >= 90, FALSE) AS level_ok,
         learners_per_teacher
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure
  WHERE school_year = '2023-24'
),
n3_rl AS (
  SELECT n3_lvl.*,
         CASE WHEN level_ok THEN PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY education_level_code, level_ok ORDER BY learners_per_teacher) END AS level_pct
  FROM n3_lvl
),
n3_a AS (
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code, COUNT_IF(offered) AS levels_offered, COUNT_IF(level_ok) AS levels_assessed,
         MAX(level_pct) AS top_level_pct,
         MAX_BY(CASE WHEN level_ok THEN education_level_code END, COALESCE(level_pct, -1.0)) AS top_level_national
  FROM n3_rl
  GROUP BY city_mun_psgc_code
),
n3 AS (
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code, levels_offered, levels_assessed, top_level_national,
         CASE WHEN levels_assessed > 0 THEN 100.0 * PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY levels_assessed > 0 ORDER BY top_level_pct) END AS ap3_pct_national
  FROM n3_a
),
ap1_prev AS (
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code,
         MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2023-24' THEN active_public_schools END) AS active_schools_2023,
         MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2022-23' THEN active_public_schools END) AS active_schools_2022,
         MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2023-24' THEN public_learners END) AS public_learners_2023,
         MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2022-23' THEN public_learners END) AS public_learners_2022,
         MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2023-24' THEN barangays_without_public_es END) AS barangays_without_es_2023,
         MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2023-24' THEN regular_barangays END) AS regular_barangays,
         MAX(population_2024) AS population_2024
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap1_school_provision
  GROUP BY city_mun_psgc_code
),
ap4 AS (
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2024 THEN school_age_population END) AS school_age_pop_2024,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2020 THEN school_age_population END) AS school_age_pop_2020,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2024 THEN enrollment_all_sectors END) AS enrollment_2024,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2020 THEN enrollment_all_sectors END) AS enrollment_2020,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2024 THEN population_enrollment_gap END) AS gap_2024,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2020 THEN population_enrollment_gap END) AS gap_2020,
         MAX(CASE WHEN reference_year = 2024 THEN gap_share END) AS gap_share_2024
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap4_population_enrollment_gap
  GROUP BY city_mun_psgc_code
),
scoped AS (
  SELECT l.lgu_label, l.province_label, l.lgu_type_label, l.land_area_sqkm,
         p.*,
         n12.ap1_pct_national, n12.ap2_pct_national, n3.ap3_pct_national, n3.top_level_national,
         CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN n12.ap1_pct_national ELSE 100.0 * p.ap1_percentile END AS ap1_pct_view,
         CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN n12.ap2_pct_national ELSE 100.0 * p.ap2_percentile END AS ap2_pct_view,
         CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN n3.ap3_pct_national ELSE 100.0 * p.ap3_percentile END AS ap3_pct_view,
         CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN p.national_tier_code ELSE p.tier_code END AS tier_code_view,
         CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN n3.top_level_national ELSE p.ap3_highest_level END AS ap3_level_view,
         a.active_schools_2023, a.active_schools_2022, a.public_learners_2023, a.public_learners_2022,
         a.barangays_without_es_2023, a.regular_barangays, a.population_2024,
         g.school_age_pop_2024, g.school_age_pop_2020, g.enrollment_2024, g.enrollment_2020, g.gap_2024, g.gap_2020, g.gap_share_2024,
         pv.poverty_incidence, pv.poverty_status
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority AS p
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN n12 ON n12.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN n3 ON n3.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN ap1_prev AS a ON a.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN ap4 AS g ON g.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_poverty AS pv ON pv.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
),
gap_ranked AS (
  SELECT scoped.*,
         CASE WHEN gap_share_2024 IS NOT NULL THEN 100.0 * PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN :rank_scope = 'National' THEN 'all' ELSE lgu_type END, gap_share_2024 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY gap_share_2024) END AS ap4_pct_view
  FROM scoped
),
board AS (
  SELECT gap_ranked.*,
         CASE tier_code_view WHEN '3' THEN 'Critical' WHEN '2' THEN 'Elevated' WHEN '1' THEN 'Targeted' WHEN '0' THEN 'Monitor' ELSE 'Data review' END AS tier_view,
         CASE tier_code_view WHEN '3' THEN 4 WHEN '2' THEN 3 WHEN '1' THEN 2 WHEN '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tier_sort_view,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN ap1_pct_view >= 90 THEN 'Schools' END,
                                          CASE WHEN ap2_pct_view >= 90 THEN 'Classrooms' END,
                                          CASE WHEN ap3_pct_view >= 90 THEN 'Teachers' END), ''), 'None high') AS high_measures_view,
         CASE WHEN is_stable THEN 'Critical in both rankings'
              WHEN tier_code = '3' THEN 'Critical within type only'
              WHEN national_tier_code = '3' THEN 'Critical nationally only'
              ELSE 'Not Critical' END AS stability,
         CASE ap3_level_view WHEN 'ES' THEN ap3_es_learners_per_teacher WHEN 'JHS' THEN ap3_jhs_learners_per_teacher
              WHEN 'SHS' THEN ap3_shs_learners_per_teacher END AS ap3_value_view,
         population_2024 / NULLIF(CAST(land_area_sqkm AS DOUBLE), 0) AS density_per_sqkm,
         LEAST(ap1_pct_view, ap2_pct_view, ap3_pct_view) AS lowest_pct_view
  FROM gap_ranked
)
SELECT board.*,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tier_sort_view DESC, affected_learners DESC, lowest_pct_view DESC, city_mun_psgc_code) AS rank_in_view,
       CASE WHEN tier_sort_view >= 3 THEN affected_learners ELSE 0 END AS learners_in_critical_elevated
FROM board
WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
) AS v
WHERE rank_in_view <= 25

         CASE tier_code_view WHEN '3' THEN 4 WHEN '2' THEN 3 WHEN '1' THEN 2 WHEN '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tier_sort_view,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN ap1_pct_view >= 90 THEN 'Schools' END,
                                          CASE WHEN ap2_pct_view >= 90 THEN 'Classrooms' END,
                                          CASE WHEN ap3_pct_view >= 90 THEN 'Teachers' END), ''), 'None high') AS high_measures_view,
         CASE WHEN is_stable THEN 'Critical in both rankings'

  FROM gap_ranked
)

       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tier_sort_view DESC, affected_learners DESC, lowest_pct_view DESC, city_mun_psgc_code) AS rank_in_view,

) AS v

         CASE p.education_level_code WHEN 'ES' THEN 1 WHEN 'JHS' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS level_sort

  WHERE p.school_year = '2023-24' AND (:region = 'All regions' OR l.region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR l.province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR l.lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
),
lv AS (
  SELECT level_name, level_sort,
         SUM(learners_in_ratio) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(teachers_in_ratio) AS DOUBLE), 0) AS learners_per_teacher,
         100.0 * SUM(learners_in_ratio) / NULLIF(SUM(level_learners), 0) AS learner_coverage_pct,
         SUM(learners_without_teachers) AS learners_without_teachers,
         SUM(zero_teacher_schools) AS zero_teacher_schools
  FROM t GROUP BY level_name, level_sort
),
f AS (
  SELECT level_name, 'National (DepEd)' AS funding, 1 AS funding_sort,
         SUM(teachers_in_ratio - sef_provincial_teachers - sef_city_municipal_teachers - lgu_funded_teachers - other_funded_teachers) AS teachers
  FROM t GROUP BY level_name
  UNION ALL SELECT level_name, 'SEF provincial', 2, SUM(sef_provincial_teachers) FROM t GROUP BY level_name
  UNION ALL SELECT level_name, 'SEF city or municipal', 3, SUM(sef_city_municipal_teachers) FROM t GROUP BY level_name
  UNION ALL SELECT level_name, 'LGU-funded', 4, SUM(lgu_funded_teachers) FROM t GROUP BY level_name

)
SELECT lv.*, f.funding, f.funding_sort, f.teachers,
       CASE WHEN f.funding_sort = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_first_row
FROM lv JOIN f ON f.level_name = lv.level_name
) AS v
WHERE funding_sort > 1

# Where does the national picture become a local concern?
ReachED ranks every city and municipality on three pressures at once (SY 2023-24): **learners per public school**, **learners per classroom** and **learners per teacher**. High (90th percentile or above) on all three is **Critical**, two **Elevated**, one **Targeted**, none **Monitor**; under 90% data coverage on any measure is **Data review**. Tiers show *relative capacity pressure*, never a count of schools, rooms or teachers needed.
